seen.where: HHStA AIS record, opened in Chrome 4 Nov 2026: https://www.archivinformationssystem.at/detail.aspx?ID=3965130 (AT-OeStA/HHStA RK Reichsakten in genere 9-3-1; the AIS page offers no image or digitised view, accessibility 'Oeffentlich', no scan linked).
seen.extent: Fol. 33-58 (26 folios) of the file, a Sammelakt of the Schmalkaldic Bundestag papers of 15 Feb - 6 Mar 1537; how much of it is cipher is not stated.
seen.cipher: AIS title (quoted): 'Akten des Bundestages zu Schmalkalden mit darauf erfolgtem Schriftenwechsel. Dr. Held an Koenig Ferdinand (chiffriert, beiliegend eine franzoesische Uebersetzung', date 1537.02.15 (umlauts omitted here). On the archive's own wording a French translation of the ciphered letter is enclosed, i.e. an attached decipherment/translation exists; the leaf itself could not be seen, so the cipher system and the translation's exact relation to it are unconfirmed.

prior_art.lasry: No Lasry or HistoCrypt item on Held or the Schmalkalden Bundestag found by web search.
prior_art.edition: No edition of this letter found; NDB (Held) cites Lanz, Korrespondenz Karls V. vol. 2, pp. 268-72 for a French instruction to Ferdinand and the Cardinal of Trent, a different text; the ACDH edition of Ferdinand's correspondence was not opened for 1537.

1755.note: AIS says Held's 15 Feb 1537 letter to Ferdinand (HHStA RK Reichsakten in genere 9-3-1, fol. 33-58) is 'chiffriert, beiliegend eine franzoesische Uebersetzung', so an attached translation exists and the item is read in part; no scan online and the leaf is unseen.
